name: Monongalia County, West Virginia (United States)
description: Blue field with a white band across the centre with gold-edged points, charged with the county seal reading MONONGALIA COUNTY OCTOBER 9, 1776 between the numerals 17 and 76 in black.
history: Monongalia County, known locally as Mon County, is a county located in West Virginia. The flag was adopted on 10 June 2022 (according to the Wikidata statement on the flag; Flags of the World records that the county commission sought designs incorporating the seal in a 2017 contest).
